title: Bun server-sent notifications
context: Pushes notifications to logged-in users over server-sent events. verifyToken resolves to a user id or null; isAdmin(userId) returns Promise<boolean>. Notification messages are free text and may contain line breaks. Disconnected clients must be cleaned up.
code: type Sub = { userId: string; send: (event: string, data: string) => void };
export function notify(userId: string, event: string, message: string) {
for (const s of subs) if (s.userId === userId) s.send(event, message);
for (const s of subs) s.send("broadcast", String(message));
if (url.pathname !== "/events") return new Response("not found", { status: 404 });

expected.why: isAdmin returns a Promise, which is always truthy, so any logged-in user can broadcast
a message containing a line break ends the data field early and corrupts SSE framing; each line needs its own data: prefix
the subscriber is never removed from subs on disconnect, so the set grows forever and notify keeps writing to closed streams
